issues.claim: Counting sort, and its application to radix sorting, were both invented by Harold H. Seward in 1954.
issues.problem: The invention of counting sort is incorrectly attributed. The algorithm was actually introduced by C. A. R. Hoare in 1954 (or earlier by other researchers), not by Harold H. Seward.
issues.fix: Correct the attribution to the proper inventor(s), e.g., "Counting sort was introduced by C. A. R. Hoare in 1954."
